title: MCP server in Python with one tool, called by an in-process client
intent: Write an MCP server with the official Python SDK and call its tool.

files.check.py:
import anyio
from mcp import Client
from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer

server = MCPServer("demo")


@server.tool()
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two numbers."""
    return a + b


async def main() -> None:
    async with Client(server) as client:
        tools = await client.list_tools()
        assert [tool.name for tool in tools.tools] == ["add"]
        result = await client.call_tool("add", {"a": 2, "b": 3})
        assert result.content[0].text == "5", result
    print("strue-ok")


anyio.run(main)

avoid.why: In mcp 2.x FastMCP was renamed; import MCPServer from mcp.server.mcpserver.
